label: H.R. 1228
title: Prioritizing Veterans’ Survivors Act

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

summary: Prioritizing Veterans' Survivors Act This bill provides that the Office of Survivors Assistance (OSA) must operate within the Office of the Secretary of the Department of Veterans Affairs. (Currently, OSA operates within the Pension and Fiduciary Service of the Veterans Benefits Administration.)
summary_short: Prioritizing Veterans' Survivors Act This bill provides that the Office of Survivors Assistance (OSA) must operate within the Office of the Secretary of the Department of Veterans Affairs.
